decision: NX-029 slice 1 (design docs/implementation/NX-029-design.md §3, owner decisions D1–D7 'all as recommended' 2026-10-10, dispatcher D8/D9): tenant-level retention (D9) for the classes the retention keeper executes in slice 1. Product defaults, not legal periods (03:96, 13:31); enterprises adjust by a new version. A derived class never outlives its source (prompt text, Claim quotes and job inputs follow the message text). Financial records and cost entries use financial_retention_days of the commercial settings (NX-027 D6), not a second value here. Expired message text, Claim quotes, prompt text and job inputs are redacted in place (rows, digests and order stay); commercial receipts, metric observations, commercial records and cost entries are deleted; every pass leaves a tombstone without content. v2 (NX-029 slice 4, NX-035 D4 confirmed by the owner 2026-10-10): records — deletion ledger and tombstones are kept 365 days, longer than the 35-day maximum backup retention, so every deletion still in a backup can be replayed after a restore (NX-035 §5, §6.2); a version with backup_max_retention_days not below both is refused. v3 (NX-029 final, AT-026): three expiry classes the keeper now executes - run_files: a Pi Run directory 30 days after its Run is terminal (queued for the Agent Host runs/purge, deleted only when the Host confirms; ADR-005, 06:92); commitment_closed: a Commitment 365 days after it was closed (fulfilled, cancelled or breached), object and ledger deleted (D4); claim_superseded: the structured value and remaining text of a superseded Claim 365 days after it was superseded, ids and the correction chain kept (D2). v4 (NX-029 completion): the remaining expiry classes of the design table - plan_closed: a plan 365 days after its last status became closed or invalidated, all versions, steps, events, Runs, outcomes and its unshared strategies deleted (D3); effect_text: the frozen request text of a terminal effect intent 90 days after it was created, states, receipts and digests kept (follows message_text; ADR-021); job_records: 365 days after a task became terminal its events, inbox and outbox rows and old idempotency records are deleted, the task row too unless a Run binding still refers to it (then its payloads are erased); model_request_manifest: model request rows and their prompt rows 365 days after the request (D3; cost entries keep their own financial retention); read_audit: read audit rows 365 days after the read, folded into per-day counts (D6); governance_audit: audit events, superseded control events (the latest per scope stays), human requests, export requests and completed deletion requests whose ledger entries are gone, 365 days after the event (D6). records: ledger entries and tombstones leave after deletion_ledger_days / tombstone_days, never while a restore replay is open; both must exceed backup_max_retention_days. v5 (NX-038 E3, owner D2 2026-10-12): semantic_access - the append-only per-access records of the Context Engine's semantic browse/resolve (term hashes, refs and counts, no text) are deleted 90 days after they were recorded; a Consumer erasure deletes the records of that Consumer's Runs when purging begins.
